title: Ordinary provider handoffs: retain exact superseded dispatch observation identity
outcome: A real provider enqueue or enqueue failure remains observable under its original prompt identity when a newer unguarded turn replaces the record's prepared observation slot, without changing dispatch or admission semantics.
acceptance: Preserve the diagnostic identity of the exact dispatch at the real provider channel send boundary, including when a newer turn starts before an older unguarded Claude/ACP dispatch is handed off; recorded session, project, prompt, source and outcome describe the dispatch actually sent.
Add a deterministic interleaving regression for the superseded unguarded dispatch and a newer turn, covering enqueue success/failure and preserving no-observation behavior for paths that do not send.
Complete the required independent review pair and relevant focused guards; the integration owner runs the exact-input full gate before landing.
